articles.title: Ex-Trump Aide Bolton Says 'I'm Sorry' in Court
articles.summary: John Bolton, who used to work for President Trump, admitted he kept secret papers and said sorry in court. He could go to prison for up to 5 years.

articles.title: World Cup Ticket Disaster: Fans Left Outside Stadiums
articles.summary: Fans who bought resale tickets for World Cup games got locked out when the tickets didn't show up. Some drove hours and spent thousands, only to watch on TV.

articles.title: King Charles Reveals Tax Bill for the First Time
articles.summary: King Charles III shared how much tax he paid for the first time ever: £12.9 million. But the royal family's public funding is going down to £99.9 million next year.
